_doc: Hand rules for naming the glacier of a Sentinel-1 timelapse from its file name (glaciers/management/commands/s1_videos.py). Keys are the site part of the file name with any trailing number or version stripped (Portage3 -> Portage). `glacier`: a glacier name to look up (RGI, GLIMS, then GNIS); `gnis`: a GNIS feature whose point places it (a lake or stream: the nearest large glacier); `unplaced`: no rule, Hig names it. `note` is shown on the review page. Sites with no entry are matched by name after the qualifier words are stripped. First written 2026-11-20 from Hig's folder of 145 videos.

Alsek-GP.note: Alsek and Grand Plateau in one view; placed on Alsek

Alsek_Lake.note: Alsek Lake, placed on Alsek Glacier's face

LGP.note: read as Lake Grand Plateau; placed on Grand Plateau Glacier (a guess)

Berg_Lake.note: Berg Lakes, placed on the nearest large glacier

Ferris_Grand_Pacific.note: Ferris and Grand Pacific; placed on Grand Pacific

Margerie_Grand_Pacific.note: Margerie and Grand Pacific; placed on Margerie

Pedersen_Aialik.note: Pedersen and Aialik; placed on Pedersen

Endicott.note: Endicott Arm; placed on Dawes Glacier at its head (a guess)

Sitkagi.note: Sitkagi Bluffs: Hig's own line named Sitkagi

Fountain.note: Fountain Stream, Malaspina's east side; nearest large glacier

Caetani.note: Caetani: Hig placed two Caetani videos on Agassiz Glacier (2026-11-18/21)

Iliamna.note: Iliamna Volcano; nearest large glacier to the summit (a guess)

McCarthy.note: McCarthy, not McCarty (there is a separate McCarty video): read as McCarthy Creek Glacier (a guess)
